evidence_policy.first_audio_definition: UtteranceProgressListener.onStart software timestamp relative to turn start; not externally measured acoustic onset
evidence_policy.cap_rule: All model artifacts resident across both app-private package inventories count; a host target becomes a physical cap claim only after an installed file-and-hash inventory proves excluded artifacts and rollback copies are absent.
evidence_policy.npu_rule: No NPU claim without a version-matched compiled artifact and runtime. Never load two QNN runtime providers in one process.

post_capture_tts_repair.historical_inventory_boundary: The Demo 1 and Demo 2 filmed physical-inventory receipts predate the later 26-candidate audition catalog and default switch.
post_capture_tts_repair.claim_boundary: Playback lifecycle and routing are phone-measured; first-audio values are in-app proxies, not microphone-observed acoustic onset. Voice preference came from the user's manual audition, not a formal listening panel.

latency_preload_handoff.claim_boundary: Warm n=1 software start proxies only. No acoustic-onset, cold/boot-to-audio, distribution, preload-causality, all-routes-resident, physical-unplug, restart/process-death recovery, background/always-on, long-duration, or whole-stack-NPU claim.
